question: For what purpose does the brahmin remove sweat-related impurity from his own body?
premises: The action concerns the brahmin's own body.
The purpose is accomplishment of the rite.
inference: The brahmin removes sweat-related impurity from his body for the accomplishment of the rite.
plain_english: On his own body, removing the fault of sweat, the brahmin does so for the accomplishment of the rite.
